Name: Oku's Suburban Farmhouse - AT

Description:
[b][color=#f4cccc][size=2]Working as of November 2024 - Please leave a comment if you are experiencing a bug[/size][/color][/b]
[color=#f1f1f1]
[/color][size=4]Ever wanted your farmhouse to look less cabin-y? Then this mod is for you <3

[/size]there are 3 siding options: beige, white, and brown
and 2 door color options: pink and black

[b][color=#f4cccc]How to get it working:[/color]
[/b]
- Have smapi installed
- Download Alternative textures
- buy the paint bucket from robin if you don't have it
- use the paint bucket on the farmhouse and you can choose my texture 

[b][color=#f4cccc]Planned updates
[/color][/b]- stages for each farmhouse upgrade 
- Seasonal variants
- fix the perspective of the house (its more upright then id like it to be lol)
I'll also take any suggestions you have :3

[b][color=#f4cccc]I'm new to modding so let me know if there's any issues!

[/color][/b]feel free to edit the png files for personal use, I don't mind.
